scene: You step off the hand-cranked trolley into vibrant Fountain Pen Lane.
picture: Side-view pixel art along a cobbled street. Far left, the wooden trolley sits on rails beside a leaky blue ink barrel. Centre, the elderly East Asian player in blue cap and orange cardigan leans on his cane. Right, a brass robot writes at a table. Far right, an open paper mill doorway awaits beneath drying sheets.
shown: a leaking wooden barrel of glowing blue ink on the far left
a brass automaton dipping a quill at a desk on the right
an open archway door beneath hanging drying sheets on the far right

variants.scene: The cart stops by glowing ink as evening settles over the quiet cobblestone lane.
